intro: A busy day for AI shopping and search: Amazon widened Shop Direct, Google opened Search and Gemini to outside apps, and Alphabet's results showed AI Mode squeezing search ads. Reddit searches were rate-limited again, so Reddit is thin.

must_reads.title: Amazon Expands Shop Direct to Keep Shoppers Off AI Agents
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Amazon now lists 250 million products it doesn't sell and sends shoppers to other stores, so it can stay the place people start shopping instead of AI agents. The fight over who owns the first click is getting sharper, and links that work across every store matter more when the big players each want to be the front door.

must_reads.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Google is letting outside apps plug straight into Search and Gemini answers. More shopping and discovery will happen inside AI answers rather than on websites, so how links get chosen and tracked in those answers is becoming a real question.

must_reads.title: Google's ad growth slows to 10.5% as AI Mode ads go to 10 more markets
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Alphabet's ad growth slowed as AI Mode took space from normal search ads, and AI Mode ads are going to 10 more markets. Fewer classic search clicks puts more weight on other routes to buyers, like creators and their links.

must_reads.title: Feedvisor Examines How Shoppers Check AI Product Recommendations
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Only 5% of people would buy straight after an AI product recommendation; most go and check reviews and other sites first. AI isn't replacing the trusted recommendation yet, which is good news for creators and the links they share.

must_reads.title: Readwise is taking on Kindle and Kobo for ebook supremacy
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Readwise is opening an ebook store to compete with Kindle and Kobo. Another place to buy books means more reasons for authors to send readers to a link that lets them pick their store.
